'''Persappa''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TUR" /> located in the [[Persappa system/Legends|Persappa system]] of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was a part of the [[Rakatan Archipelago]], a fragmented group of unaligned planets [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] by tribes of the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]] after the collapse of the Rakatan [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]<ref name="TUR" /> around [[25,200 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Persappa featured bubbling brew pools on its surface.<ref name="TUR" />

The Rakatan tribe that settled Persappa brought guard creatures there, including [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]],<ref name="TUR" /> a species of [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]] [[Reptomammal/Legends|reptomammals]] [[Homeworld/Legends|originating]] on the<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC Dathomir Ottethan">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Dathomir system/Legends|Dathomir]] and [[Ottethan system/Legends|Ottethan systems]]</ref> worlds of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] and [[Ottethan/Legends|Ottethan]].<ref name="NEGAS" /> Due to [[Reproduction/Legends|overbreeding]], however, the rancors on Persappa eventually [[Mutant|mutated]] into a [[Persappa rancor|variant]] that was [[Color/Legends|blue]]-spotted and [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibious]], and the creatures lurked in the planet's brew pools.<ref name="TUR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Persappa was introduced in ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', a [[2010]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TUR" />
